what: joint.sweep of the hinged arm towards a grounded block
method: Base: box 20x20x10 from (-10,-10,-10), grounded; Arm: box 40x10x10 from (0,-5,0), centre (20,0,5); Stop: box 50x10x10 from (-10,30,0), grounded; the arm's corner (40,5) turned θ reaches y = 40 sin θ + 5 cos θ, which is 30 at θ = asin(30/√1625) - atan(5/40) = 40.9676; the sweep from 0 to 120 stops there
